checklist.dimension: Stage order, fail-closed, source order, source errors not hidden
checklist.evidence: AccessPipeline.php:31-67 resolves restrictions, then boundary, before, authority, restrictions only on Allow, then confirm, then after. BeforeStage.php:41-47 returns only Deny or HookError; BeforeResult has Continue/Deny only. AfterStage.php:34-36 logs and does not replace the decision. AuthorityStage.php:103-140 and ReadAttempt.php:82-146 read every grant source before qualification; a throwable becomes SourceError or ConsistencyError for the whole decision. EnginePropertiesTest P8/P12 and CRM SourcesTest R44 passed in V1.

checklist.dimension: PolicyOnly reads no assignment state; policy true cannot replace grants
checklist.evidence: PrepareStage.php:131-133 opens ReadAttempt only for Grants. PolicyDecider.php:80-90 denies false/null Policy and Grants false; a bool true or an unqualified allow Response does not Allow. AuthorityStage.php:51-89 qualifies only Grants, then membership, then policy veto, then NotGranted. CRM AuthorityModesTest R61 recorded zero SQL on a connection that aborts every statement and a CodeStateToken; R62/R63 deny policy-true and superadmin substitutes for a missing grant or a PolicyOnly veto.

checklist.dimension: Scope, exact expiry, conditions and role filters AND per witness; contributions OR
checklist.evidence: Grant.php:93-96 and RoleContribution.php:59-62 treat expiresAt == now as expired. AuthorityStage.php:142-248 skips a witness on expiry, scope, eligibility or any false condition, and sets qualified only after that witness passes; a condition or eligibility throwable denies the decision. ScopeEligibility.php:61-87 AND-combines matching role filters, then the external adapter. forContribution keeps that grant and role. CRM R11/R13/R14 use literal DecisionReason expectations; mutations.json shows AND-to-OR and seller-filter removal fail those tests.

checklist.dimension: Four scope policies, resource/tenant owner, global ordinary, invalid refs
checklist.evidence: EvaluationFrame.php:69-91: isolated or global context queries only the selected scope; inherit/required add tenant-wide; allowGlobalRoles also queries the global tenant. BoundaryStage.php:48-118 and 130-157 deny TenantRequired, TenantMismatch, AssignmentScopeMismatch, ResourceScopeMissing, AssignmentScopeRequired and AssignmentScopeNotAccepted, including an explicit tenant/context that disagrees with the resource owner. AuthorityStage.php:150-154 drops a non-matching tenant unless the role class is allowlisted. ScopePropertiesTest P4 covers the 12-cell table; P13 covers foreign and ordinary global grants.

checklist.dimension: Superadmin only in Grants, after witness qualification, without implicit exemptions
checklist.evidence: qualify() is Grants-only. Superadmin is set at AuthorityStage.php:227-238 only after expiry, role identity, scope, eligibility and conditions. MembershipRestriction.php:64-66 returns exemptsSuperAdmin false and AuthorityStage.php:60-66 always applies it. RestrictionStage.php:75-78 skips a restriction only when that restriction exempts. Owner and common eligibility run in BoundaryStage before authority. isSuperAdmin uses the same qualify path and is not an access decision. SuperAdminTest and CRM R17 passed in V1.

checklist.dimension: Early raw T_before/T_after including dynamic Prepare overlay, max 3 whole-attempt retries
checklist.evidence: ReadAttempt.php:202-247 records state in begin() before permissions or assignments; catalog() uses that same attempt. confirm() at 149-175 re-reads materialized fenced sources and throws ReadAttemptChanged. Authorizer.php:83-93 retries the whole prepare/evaluate on attempt 0 and 1 and returns ConsistencyError on attempt 2. PrepareStage.php:98-110 rethrows ReadAttemptChanged from the dynamic overlay. DatabaseSource readPermissions/readAssignments used by the engine are unfenced; the attempt owns the fence. Cache freshness, Redis, replica and transaction protocols stay with P4.14/P4.20/P4.21.

checklist.dimension: Unknown, former and NotGrantable role keys grant nothing; no FQCN storage
checklist.evidence: PermissionGrammar.php:59-62 role keys match a panel-id pattern, so a class name cannot be a key. RoleGrant.php:20-22 builds RoleKey from the stored role string. AuthorityStage.php:160-172 continues with former_role_key, unknown_role or not_grantable_role; only a FolderSource GrantedAutomatically contribution may bypass grantable=false. RoleCompiler.php:181-186 rejects PolicyOnly permissions on a role. CRM R66 and DatabaseReadsTest malformed-identity SourceError passed in V1.

checklist.dimension: Built-in sources stay inside the D15 section 7 allowlist; arch checks are effective
checklist.evidence: D15 section 7 allows Contracts, public Kernel values, Panel/PanelCatalog, BaseRole, PermissionDefinition/PolicyBinding, public scope values, and Storage only for DatabaseSource. AuthorizationArchTest.php:9-18 forbids AzGuard\Authorization under Sources and proves a scratch source importing Authorizer goes red. ZonesArchTest.php:155-169 and 266-270 keep Storage off every source except Database. Arch executor result: 72 tests, 314 assertions, exit 0.

checklist.dimension: Generic model=null resolution does not query; typed, native and external DI is correct
checklist.evidence: BoundaryStage.php:94 calls definition->resolve() and does not call query(). ScopeEligibility.php:96-101 returns before EligibilityBuilder when there are no native filters; ScopeConfiguration.php:34-35 rejects native filters on model=null. EligibilityBuilder.php:39-67 gives each filter a fresh nested predicate and RuntimeInvoker named user/role/grant/actor inputs. RuntimeInvoker.php:64-67 refuses to let the container invent a Model. CRM ExternalScopeTest R19 and RuntimeInputsTest required-user denial passed in V1.

checklist.dimension: CRM controls are literal, V15 in-slice properties are present, residuals are explicit
checklist.evidence: CrmWorld.php:145-151 asserts a caller-supplied allow flag and DecisionReason, not a recomputed decision. Mutations R11/R13/R14 changed production copies in scratch only and the mutants failed. EnginePropertiesTest and ScopePropertiesTest contain P1-P8, P10-P13 and P15. P9, P14 and P16 remain named for P4.11, P4.23 and P4.20 in D14 section 7. Malformed dynamic rows, single-pass generators, Fiber-local CurrentContext/WithinContext finally, and per-contribution condition frames were inspected and do not show a blocker or major.
